ResourceComplianceTimeline.description_en: The compliance evaluation history of the resource

AccountId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account

AvailabilityZone.description_en: The zone where the resource resides

ResourceCreateTime.description_en: The timestamp when the resource was created

ResourceStatus.description_en:
The status of the resource. The resource status is defined by the corresponding Alibaba Cloud service. This parameter can be empty. For example:

If the resource type is ACS::ECS::Instance, the resource is stateful. In this case, the value of this parameter is Running or Stopped.

If the resource type is ACS::OSS::Bucket, the resource is stateless. In this case, the value of this parameter is empty
ResourceStatus.description_zh:
资源状态。资源状态取决于各云服务对其的定义，该参数可能为空。例如：

当资源类型为ACS::ECS::Instance时，由于ECS实例有状态，因此该参数为Running或Stopped。

当资源类型为ACS::OSS::Bucket时，由于OSS Bucket无状态，因此该参数为空
